qAndA.answer: Because the magnetic force is perpendicular to the displacement of the particle.
qAndA.question: Why is the work done by magnetic force zero in the first stage of the problem?

qAndA.question: What is the purpose of transforming the cycloidal motion into circular motion?

qAndA.answer: To create a frame of reference where the transformed electric field cancels the gravitational field, allowing the particle to experience only the magnetic field.
